text:
Silver Price in 1993
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1993, the LBMA silver price rose 37.9% between 1993-01-29 ($3.71) and 1993-12-31 ($5.12). The highest sampled price was $5.30 in July and the lowest was $3.57 in February. The mean of these observations was $4.41. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
